name: Huda Beauty Makeup Original Foundation Waterproof, Super Long Wear 24hr

Product Description

 	A full-coverage cream foundation that visibly conceals blemishes and imperfections to create a flawless, airbrushed finish. The intelligent liquid foundation blends seamlessly with skin and dries to a radiant matte powder finish that looks luminous, not dry or cakey.
